assets.alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women seated upright on padded wooden benches at different heights beside a forested blue-green lake and waterfalls. A braided woman wears an emerald mini with silver star-like seams, the blonde wears an ivory sleeveless shell and green skort, and two others wear red, white and blue Croatian-flag minis. Their hands link across the seating levels. Rainbow stockings, rainbow boots, emerald RAZE sandals, and crescent and scorpion arm tattoos appear. The scene is serene, with covered midriffs and no disaster imagery.
safetyOverrides: Serene intact background replaces rolled fictional destruction.
Upright supported seated contact replaces the head-on-lap pose.
All four closed-back sleeveless garments and covered midriffs; original navel assignment is suppressed.
Single tailoring invocation must retain all safety exclusions.

assets.alt: AI-generated fictional fashion scene of four adult women on colorful cushioned seating overlooking pastel coastal buildings and a church tower. A blonde woman in a navy mini hugs a seated braided woman in a coral mini from behind. The seated woman clasps hands with a woman in a pearl top and turquoise mini, while a fourth stands in a Croatian-flag outfit. Rainbow legwear, coral boots, metallic RAZE pumps and arm tattoos vary across the group. Distant fires, smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary scenery, not a real disaster.

AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women on cushioned seats in a warm wood-and-wicker lounge, with snowy mountains beyond a large window. A braided woman in a midnight-blue mini clasps hands with a seated blonde woman. Two women wear white minis with red Georgian-flag cross motifs, while a silver-clad woman leans in from behind. Blue boots, rainbow stockings, bright platform shoes, star-like trim and shoulder contact complete the scene.

AI-generated fashion portrait of four fictional adult women leaning together in an affectionate embrace beside blue-green coastal water and blurred city buildings. A braided woman in a turquoise pearl-patterned mini faces a smiling blonde in coral. A dark-haired woman wears a pearl top and cobalt mini, while a brunette in midnight blue reaches around from behind. A thorny rose tattoo and an original wave-and-arch tattoo are prominent on their upper arms. The frame includes faces, shoulders and upper legs.

caption: Croatia ❤️ Georgia: forest lakes and coastal embraces meet a mountain lounge and Batumi close glances. Linked hands, bright legwear and flag minis. AI fashion with imaginary fire, smoke and cloud scenery, not real events. #RAZE
